name: Psychology PhD
detailsNote: Official annual dates; Fall 2027 not confirmed. Detailed requirements below concern Cognitive Neuroscience unless otherwise labeled. One Psychology PhD application permits multiple training selections.

applicationFee.note: International degree fee $70. Only qualifying degrees/affiliations waive fees; confirm category. International applicants should confirm the applicable category and documentation before payment.

english.note: Central PTE58; two-year validity; qualifying country/recent-degree exemptions. Higher program requirements possible.

documents: Cognitive Neuroscience statement of interest and faculty fit
Optional scientific writing sample for Cognitive Neuroscience
requirements.note: Select Psychology PhD and training area(s) in supplement. Cognitive Neuroscience suspends GRE use; I/O requires GRE, so no single umbrella GRE rule. Three references required, but instructions allow initial review with two received. Faculty mentorship model; specify potential advisers. Other tracks have distinct writing/supplement requirements.

funding.note: Support intended throughout training but contingent on funds and progress; no guarantee beyond first year. Assistantships generally include monthly stipend and tuition waiver.
